content:
marco: Heads-up team 0 we've got the Price Spotlight micro-slate going to staging tonight. Need final FAQ copy, calculator gating, and routing rules for webinar invites.
elaine: For FAQ let's do a "one-liner + link" style. Three Qs: billing, commitments, data privacy. Keep language customer-facing, <25 words.
kevin: Tier names proposal: Starter / Team / Committed -> Lite, Team, Committed. New micro-phrases under each to call out 'reserved capacity' vs 'pay-as-you-go'.
sam: Routing suggestion: lightweight previews -> SDR queue; full-download email captures -> Growth AE; strong signals >= $10k ARR -> Enterprise AE. Use tag: spotlight_estimator.
nina: Calculator UX idea: immediate 2-line preview (est monthly + per-1k-token cost). Full CSV download and latency table only after email capture. Ops want p95 estimates in the CSV.
toni: Can we surface a tiny benchmark card under results: "Representative: Hosted API ~120ms median; Dedicated p95 <30ms" and link to the public bench doc. Tone: factual, conservative.
marco: Yes. Keep bench claim conservative and link to the benchmark narrative doc (internal).
kevin: CTA copy test: Variant A "Estimate your bill" Variant B "See price range" Variant C "Get a detailed CSV". We'll see which drives email captures.
ash: Send cohorts for webinar invite: 1) trials last 60d, 2) estimator users last 30d, 3) high-usage customers >50k tokens last 30d. Two CTAs on page: register webinar + request demo.
sam: UTMs: ?utm_source=spotlight&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=spotlight_launch_2026. We'll tag leads with hidden param src=spotlight_estimator.
growth-bot: created tags: spotlight_estimator_v1, webinar_spotlight_2026; webhooks configured at /hooks/spotlight_estimator and /hooks/webinar_spotlight.
kevin: Question: require email before showing the latency delta? My vote: show latency delta in preview for transparency, but gate the CSV and comparative table behind email.
nina: Agreed. Preview should show cost + a single-line p95 delta. The detailed per-config table goes to CSV after email capture. Track downloads.
toni: For benchmarking narrative on the page: short paragraph linking to a longer benchmark doc and a 'read the full bench' link. Emphasize representative workload and conservative numbers.
marco: Analytics: track spotlight_preview_shown, spotlight_email_captured, spotlight_csv_download, faq_click, faq_expand, sales_handshake. Fire sales_handshake when SFDC owner is assigned.
growth-bot: Events registered: spotlight_preview_shown, spotlight_email_captured, spotlight_csv_download, faq_click, faq_expand, sales_handshake. Payloads include tag=spotlight_estimator_v1.
kevin: A/B tests to wire: price ranges vs exact price; CTA wording variants; FAQ inline vs accordion. Also test default slider value 5k vs 20k tokens.
nash: I'll coordinate webinar invites and two landing pages for A/B test. Registration copy will mention "live demo + Q&A on dedicated performance".
sam: Timeline: copy freeze EOD tomorrow; staging QA Wed; soft-launch Thu AM; webinar registration opens Fri.
toni: I'll post the FAQ copy snippets in Figma and link them here. Also adding recommended micro-phrasing under tiers.
nina: One more analytics ask: add event spotlight_quality_signal when user toggles "show ops impact" (to measure platform buyer intent).
growth-bot: event added: spotlight_quality_signal.
marco: Great work. I'll assemble the launch checklist and assign owners. Ping me when copy is uploaded to staging. :white_check_mark:
